name: Ability Check
description: Roll d20 plus relevant ability modifier, adding proficiency bonus if proficient in the applicable skill or tool.

name: Advantage and Disadvantage
description: With advantage roll two d20s and use the higher; with disadvantage use the lower. Multiple sources do not stack, and advantage and disadvantage cancel.

name: Passive Checks
description: Passive check total is 10 + modifiers, with +5 for advantage or -5 for disadvantage.

name: Contests
description: When efforts directly oppose each other, participants make relevant ability checks and compare totals; ties preserve the existing situation.

name: Proficiency Bonus
description: Add proficiency bonus once to an applicable roll unless a feature changes it; proficiency scales by character level.

name: Skills with Different Abilities
description: The DM can call for a skill proficiency with a different ability score when the task calls for it, such as Strength (Intimidation).
